4186-4279-6634.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4186-4279-6634.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.

1339-2921-3394.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2921-3394.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2158-3249-5075--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3249-5075--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

997-3147-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Azorius Chancery.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Azorius Chancery from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

475-5641-6824-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-5641-6824-7810.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

647-2440-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
647-2440-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

2034-5795-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

2653-2893-4826-6168.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1168-1651-1770-2573-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-1770-2573-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-1770-2573-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Elesh Norn, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

478-804-1358-2821-6745.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts. Uthros has twelve or more charge counters on it
478-804-1358-2821-6745.description:
Animate Candelabra using Sydri.
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Uthros, Titanic Godcore by paying {U} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Uthros, Titanic Godcore.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-1322-5231.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3750-3980-5116-5793.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sisay's Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2092-3789-4131.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
2092-3789-4131.description:
Activate The Blackstaff of Waterdeep by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

2034-5551-5552.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2034-5551-5552.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lazotep Convert, adding {C}{C}.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Repeat from step 4.

855-1495-4120.easyPrerequisites: Triskelion has a +1/+1 counter on it.
855-1495-4120.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
855-1495-4120.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

321-4191-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least two, or you have cast at least one spell this turn.
321-4191-4740.description:
Cast Hibernation Sliver by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Hibernation Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1987-4423-5034-5243.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sol Ring by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sol Ring.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2034-4535-5189.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-4535-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling creature token enters the battlefield, triggering Good-Fortune Unicorn, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Saproling token.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a Saproling, creating another 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling creature token enters the battlefield, triggering Good-Fortune Unicorn, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Saproling token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Saproling token without a +1/+1 counter, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

464-781.easyPrerequisites: Fraying Sanity is attached to an opponent.
464-781.description:
Cast Traumatize by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing an opponent to mill half their library, rounded down.
At the beginning of your end step, Fraying Sanity triggers, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the number of cards put into their graveyard this turn.
